before.cause: nothing consumed github_deliveries except workgraph-reconcile.timer every 15 minutes; cmd/worker had no handler and was not deployed

after.method: signed check_run webhooks posted to the live endpoint, timed until processed_at was set
after.change: workgraph-worker.service projects deliveries on a 5s poll

note: The before figures are a 48-hour population; the after figures are three individual deliveries against a running worker. They are not the same kind of measurement, and the after set is too small to quote a percentile from.
